- Date range covered by your most recent Type II report (start/end)
- Whether you can provide a bridge letter if the coverage ends before 2027-01-31
- Any procurement deadlines we should be aware of for acceptance (PO cutoffs, signatures)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
